image_description: A still life composition featuring three white ceramic coffee cups on saucers arranged on a wooden table. One cup is upright in the center, one is tilted on its side to the right, and one is in the background. Scattered coffee beans surround the cups. To the left, there are decorative elements including a pinecone, acorns, and a burlap sack. In the background, out-of-focus glass containers are visible. Text at the bottom reads 'Cups And Beans' and 'project26c • photography'.

Several coffee beans lack distinct creases and appear slightly melted or fused into the wooden surface texture, lacking sharp contact shadows.

The elliptical opening of the tilted cup is geometrically accurate, but the transition from the rim to the body shows very subtle smoothing/warping that lacks the crisp edge definition of real ceramic.
